question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

The company is looking for some ______________(idle) workers who can join the organisation immediately.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"idle"** means avoiding work; being lazy or inactive. (आलसी)

 
 
• **Example:** He spent the whole day idle, not doing any work at all.
 
 
 
• **"Diligent"** refers to showing care and conscientiousness in one's work or duties; being hardworking. (मेहनती)
 
 
• **Example:** She is a diligent student, always completing her assignments on time.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'idle'** is **'diligent'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: '**Option 1**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Coy** (शर्मीला): Being shy or modest, often in a playful or provocative way.

 
 
• **Example:** She gave him a coy smile and looked away.
 
 
 
• **Callous** (निर्दयी): Showing or having an insensitive and cruel disregard for others.
 
 
• **Example:** His callous comments about the accident offended everyone.
 
 
 
• **Sober** (संजीदा): Serious, sensible, and solemn.
 
 
• **Example:** After the accident, he became much more sober and reflective.
